After beating floor 20 (think ascensions if you've played Slay the Spire) I went back to just casual floor 1 runs for the occasional replay. This is a great game to play if you really just want to pass some time and have some fun with mechanics without having to think too hard about it. I can certainly say that time flies and that the mechanics always leave me wanting to explore them more thoroughly. Furthermore, the modded community for this game is vibrant, so you should have no issue finding something that suits your fancy there.

Billionaire:
Gives 0 coins. Makes adjacent Cheese and Wine give 2x coins. Gives 39 coins when destroyed.

'Guillotine' item:

'Guillotine' essence:

Super fun! Because your options and power-ups are randomized every game, you can't really get too bogged down in any kind of "min-maxing" mindset and are forced to adapt your play style with every single slot spin. I eventually figured out which strategies I preferred to go for when playing, but the random nature of what you get made every single attempt a challenge.

A nice game to play after a long day, it's fun to try out different combinations, if you like the demo you will like the game. Would recommend to a casual player or someone who likes puzzle/optimization games.

Fun roguelike that you can play with one hand while smoking, which makes it even better than real slot machines that you would have to have a free hand to feed coins. Far cheaper than real slots too, 3.50$ (sale price) for over 6 hours played so far. Even if you're playing nickel slots you'll lose more than that in 20 minutes IRL
Pretty fun game especially to play idly while watching something else. Main problem is that you are almost entirely at the mercy of RNG and there's not a lot of build variety.
The best "just one more round" I've played in years. Frustrating when you get bad symbols throughout a run, but then you suddenly get *that* run and it all pops off.

Really basic but very fun and scratches my gambling-tism.

If you're gonna complain and not recommend because it's RNG based and you can't control a lot of your luck, remember: You are literally playing a slot machine based game with LUCK literally in the name.

Essentially a perfect game. There's no meaningless fluff - just gameplay. And oh boy does that gameplay keep giving!

One thing that really stands out about this Luck be a Landlord is that, in the space of modern rogue-likes, it has a difficulty much higher than most, which in a numerical game (as opposed to a mechanical one) is what makes gameplay interesting in the first place. You can't skip everything other than the Exodia-parts, you have to take a lot of mediocre symbols and make them work. I don't know how it's been done, but the difficulty curve is so excellent, every payment is thrilling and close, but doable.

This has to be the most well-balanced rogue-like I've played alongside Slay the Spire, highly reccomended.

Fun game, you may fall victim to "one more spin" mentality like me though, so beware. Has fun synergies to go for and is just very satisfying to play. Also, cats are up there for the unit with the highest cap for money-making in the game, which is pretty funny. You do need some specific relics for that though.
Did not expect to like this game, but here we are: I'm enthralled. The scope of the achievements is a bonus for me & enhances replay value.

It's a slot machine rougelite. Deceptively simple, actually very challenging in practice. Very fun too. I've complained in the past about rougelites that make the player rely too heavily on RNG for their wins, and even though this games does that I'm not complaining this time. Why is that? Well, each game lasts ten or fifteen minutes if you win. If you lose, you probably lost at the start and less than five minutes of your life was taken by the game. Compare that to, say, Risk of Rain 2 where I can invest an hour or more of my life into a god run only to be killed instantly in a single second due to some bad luck or a glitch. It stings less to lose in Luck be a Landlord, and it makes it much more enjoyable enjoyable to keep replaying even if I go all night without a win.

A great side game to play, perfect for taking small breaks if you're trying to work. It's a fun and interesting system and the updates keep making it better!

Luck be a Landlord is a fun little mix of random slots & roguelike hedging of bets. Will you get the items to make your cat tokens a money-making sensation? Or will you despair as the slots leave you hanging time after time?

Simple to learn, with plenty of replayability, its a fun game to do when killin' time.

Fun 10-20 hour game. Have more control than you would think at first with slot machines, compared to cloverpit. This one you have more control because you actually pick what symbols go in the spins. Like adding cards to a deck. Having more control outside the spins makes it feel less like gambling and pure rng. Similar to balatro.
